Every order in the Acme dashboard shows one of these statuses.

| Status    | Meaning                                              |
| --------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| Pending   | The customer placed the order but hasn't paid yet    |
| Paid      | Payment went through and the order waits for packing |
| Shipped   | The order left the warehouse                         |
| Cancelled | The order was stopped before it shipped              |

A pending order is cancelled automatically after 48 hours.
